title: Morphological Analysis and Chemical Composition of a SOFC Single Fabricated via Tape-Casting and Screen Printing
content: The development of solid oxide fuel cells (SOFCs) has gained significant interest as high-efficiency energy conversion devices, primarily due to the incorporation of novel ceramic materials that enable lower operating temperatures. Additionally, soft chemistry techniques have allowed for better stoichiometric control of each composition, leading to the synthesis of nanomaterials with enhanced catalytic activity and improved charge carrier at the Triple Phase Boundary (TPB), a crucial process for energy generation in Intermediate-Temperature SOFCs (IT-SOFCs) [1,2].
